blocks.title: Can't Recreate Key Vault After Deletion · Control-Plane Evaluation Chain

hops.detail: New-AzKeyVault / az keyvault create request is well-formed for the target resource group and location
Key Vault names are globally unique; a soft-deleted vault still owns the name and blocks same-name recreation
Deleted vault is retained in removed state for the configured retention period unless explicitly purged
Purge protection was enabled — purge may be blocked until scheduledPurgeDate; verify before forcing purge, as purge is irreversible

blocks.title: Soft-deleted vaults blocking recreation

rows.action: Retry New-AzKeyVault only after purge completes

blocks.title: Purge soft-deleted vault and recreate clean
blocks.diff:
# Blocked: VaultAlreadyExists on recreate
- New-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-prod' -Location 'eastus'
+ # Confirm the soft-deleted vault holding the name
+ Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Where-Object VaultName -eq 'kv-prod-01'
+ # Purge the soft-deleted vault (irreversible)
+ Remove-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-prod-01' -Location 'eastus' -InRemovedState -Force
+ # Verify the name is released
+ Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState -VaultName 'kv-prod-01' -Location 'eastus' # expect no result
+ # Recreate clean vault
+ New-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-prod' -Location 'eastus' -EnablePurgeProtection -SoftDeleteRetentionInDays 90
+ Get-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-prod'
+ # az keyvault create --name kv-prod-01 --resource-group rg-prod --location eastus --enable-purge-protection

blocks.title: Can't Recreate Key Vault After Deletion · Audit & Activity Log

events.detail: Vault deleted but moved to soft-deleted state; name, keys, secrets and certificates retained for recovery
Same-name create failed: a vault with the same name exists in soft-deleted state in eastus
Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState confirms blocking vault with purge protection enabled; purge is irreversible and may wait until scheduledPurgeDate

recommendedActions.label: Purge Soft-Deleted Vault & Recreate
recommendedActions.description: Irreversibly purge the removed vault to release the name, verify release, then recreate a clean vault with purge protection and 90-day retention

recommendedActions.label: Inspect Soft-Deleted Vaults

recommendedActions.command: Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Format-List VaultName,Location,EnablePurgeProtection,ScheduledPurgeDate; az keyvault list-deleted --query "[].{name:name,location:properties.location,purgeDate:properties.scheduledPurgeDate}" -o table

blocks.title: Azure Storage Blob Upload Failing — AuthorizationPermissionMismatch · Control-Plane Evaluation Chain

hops.detail: spn-contoso-datalake-ingest authenticated; Contributor allows management of stcontosofinlake01, not data operations
PutBlob requires Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/write — absent without Storage Blob Data Contributor/Owner
Blob service rejects request at container scope; no SAS/SharedKey fallback permitted by pipeline (AAD auth-mode login)
Grant Storage Blob Data Contributor at storage-account (or ingest container) scope only — do not elevate to Owner

blocks.title: RBAC Assignments — spn-contoso-datalake-ingest on stcontosofinlake01
Grant Storage Blob Data Contributor (PowerShell 7 / Azure CLI)
blocks.diff:
- # Contributor cannot PutBlob: it has no Microsoft.Storage/.../blobs/write dataAction
- az role assignment list --assignee spn-contoso-datalake-ingest --scope $scope -o table
+ $scope = "/subscriptions/<sub-id>/resourceGroups/rg-contoso-fin-data/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/stcontosofinlake01"
+ $spId = (Get-AzADServicePrincipal -DisplayName "spn-contoso-datalake-ingest").Id
+ # Least-privilege data-plane grant at storage-account scope (narrow to container if possible)
+ New-AzRoleAssignment -ObjectId $spId -RoleDefinitionName "Storage Blob Data Contributor" -Scope $scope
+ # Azure CLI equivalent:
+ # az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $spId --assignee-principal-type ServicePrincipal --role "Storage Blob Data Contributor" --scope $scope
+ Get-AzRoleAssignment -ObjectId $spId -Scope $scope | Format-Table RoleDefinitionName, Scope
+ # Wait 5-10 min for RBAC propagation, then verify with AAD login:
+ az storage blob upload --account-name stcontosofinlake01 --container-name ingest --name smoke.txt --file ./smoke.txt --auth-mode login

blocks.title: Azure Storage Blob Upload Failing — AuthorizationPermissionMismatch · Audit & Activity Log

events.detail: HTTP 403: This request is not authorized to perform this operation using this permission — first failure after 09:15 UTC
Role list confirms only Contributor + inherited Reader; no Storage Blob Data Contributor/Owner assignment found
Pipeline retry to container 'ingest' fails identically — deterministic RBAC denial, not transient/network

recommendedActions.label: Stage Blob Data Contributor Grant
recommendedActions.description: Create Storage Blob Data Contributor assignment for spn-contoso-datalake-ingest at stcontosofinlake01 scope, then wait for propagation

recommendedActions.label: Inspect Current Assignments & Verify
recommendedActions.description: List effective assignments and retry PutBlob with AAD login after 5-10 minutes to confirm 403 is cleared
recommendedActions.command: az role assignment list --assignee spn-contoso-datalake-ingest --include-inherited --query '[].{Role:roleDefinitionName,Scope:scope}' -o table; az storage blob upload --account-name stcontosofinlake01 --container-name ingest --name smoke.txt --file ./smoke.txt --auth-mode login
